t: DEWALT DWS773-GB 216mm single-bevel sliding compound mitre saw is a robust electric woodworking tool designed for precise cross-cuts and angled timber cuts. The 240V mitre saw is ideal for professional carpenters, joiners, and keen DIY enthusiasts tackling tasks such as cutting skirting boards, architraves, or decking. Features a powerful 1300W motor for efficient performance, and offers a 250 x 62mm maximum cross-cut capacity. Durable back fence, accurate mitre detents, and reliable bevel stops ensure consistent precision for repeated wood cuts. Integrated carry handles allow for easy transportation, and an electronic blade brake enhances user safety. Compatible with DEWALT Airlock. Supplied with blade.
